result.summary: The home screen is mostly intact, but one defect stands out: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' card is cut off mid-letter, even though there is plenty of free space to its right. No other broken elements were found, aside from intentional carousel and viewport clipping.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the first 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Rame' followed by a partial letter: the final 'n' is sliced vertically. The title container appears too narrow or has overflow hidden, although there is ample empty space before the rating '4.8 (500+)' on the right.
issues.suggestion: Remove the fixed or max width on the title element so it can fill the space up to the rating (e.g. flex: 1 with min-width: 0). If truncation is ever needed, use text-overflow: ellipsis rather than hard clipping mid-glyph.
